title: Comment on Notion pages with AI after reviewing the words
h1: leave a useful notion comment where it belongs
description: Have a bot post a focused Notion page comment or reply in an existing discussion. Review the destination and wording, with clear sending controls.
answer: a bot can put your review note on a notion page or add it to an existing discussion. it needs the destination reference and the comment text, and it cannot start a new inline discussion on a specific block. comments count as sends in dusk bot, so posting asks you first by default, unless you set a daily amount the bot may send on its own. a bot on **Full access** with no sending rule may post up to 25 a day without asking.
og_line: a review note in its intended discussion.
what:
you can ask for a page-level comment when feedback applies to the whole document. paste the page link or name the page. to reply in a comment thread that's already there, point the bot at that comment and it finds the thread.

choose the destination before approving the text. this action accepts either a page or an existing discussion, but not a new block-specific inline thread. a request such as "comment on this sentence" needs clarification about where the comment will actually appear.
uses: ask a document owner to clarify one disputed delivery date
reply in the existing design-review discussion with your agreed choice
leave a page-level question about a missing source behind a forecast

routine.message: every other tuesday at 16:20, read the notion proposal page i linked for silvermere instruments and prepare one page-level comment about any delivery date that contradicts the date i confirmed here. show the exact page and wording in this chat, and wait for my approval before posting. report the posted comment reference afterwards. never invent a deadline or create extra comments for the same unresolved question.
routine.needs: notion connected, with read and write access and comment permission; sending set to ask
routine.output:
comment awaiting approval
page: silvermere instruments proposal
text: the brief says delivery is friday, but our confirmed date is the following monday. could you clarify which date this proposal uses?

steps: enable notion for the review bot in **Connected apps**, using **read and write** so it can post comments.
choose **Ask every time** under **Sending on your behalf** and check the destination page is accessible.
ask for one short proposed comment, naming whether it belongs to the page or an existing discussion.
read the approval card before allowing the post, then check it in notion before scheduling repeat reviews.
watch: with **Full access** and no sending rule of its own, a bot may send up to 25 a day without asking; a daily allowance can also remove individual prompts.
creating a new inline discussion on a specific block is outside this action; use a page comment or reply to an existing discussion.
show the surrounding comments before replying so the bot uses the intended thread.

faq.q: can it reply to a notion comment that is already there?
faq.a: yes. point it at the comment; it reads the thread first, then replies in it.

faq.q: can i keep the feedback private until i approve?
faq.a: have the bot prepare the words in dusk chat and keep sending on **Ask every time**. posting is the step that places the note in notion.
